questions.stem:
There are 6245 golf balls to be packed into boxes of 35. How many boxes will be filled and how many golf balls will be left over?
Provide your answer in the form "boxes, left over" (e.g. 178, 15).

steps.explain: Divide 6245 by 35. Start by dividing 62 by 35.
Subtract 35 from 62 and bring down 4 to make 274.
Divide 274 by 35. Try multiplying 35 by 7.
Subtract 245 from 274 and bring down 5 to make 295.
Divide 295 by 35. Try multiplying 35 by 8.
Subtract 280 from 295 to find the remainder of leftover balls.
So, 178 boxes are filled and 15 golf balls are left over.
